note: US Sesame Street links from the October 2026 sweep (links-yt-official, links-yt-community). `defaults` applies to every record that does not set the field; `completenessNotes` holds the completeness note named by a record's completenessStatus. titleEn is the upload's or listing's own title.

defaults.notes: Community upload. The uploader is not verified as the rights holder; availability may change.
defaults.verification: Public metadata read by the October 2026 Sesame Street sweep (links-yt-official, links-yt-community); title, link, uploader and listed duration checked; playback not tested.
defaults.tagEvidence: Characters named in the Muppet Wiki summary of the episode, or in the upload's title; editorial and not exhaustive.
defaults.completenessNote: Metadata checked only. No playback, end-to-end review or reference comparison.

availabilityCheck.method: listing read by the sweep (metadata only)
availabilityCheck.result: Listed; no failure recorded. Not a playback check.

completenessNotes.ss-01: Numbered upload is shorter than an episode; exact segment extent needs review.
completenessNotes.ss-02: Uploader presents a numbered episode, with no partial or excerpt qualifier; metadata only. No playback or reference comparison.
completenessNotes.ss-03: Uploader label requires review; a recreation or ambiguous episode label does not establish the original broadcast.
completenessNotes.ss-04: The whole-episode wording conflicts with a short listing runtime for this era; completeness is unresolved.
completenessNotes.ss-05: Part labels are uploader labels. Continuity, missing parts and completeness have not been checked.
completenessNotes.ss-06: Official street-story/short excerpt. A full street story is only one component of a broadcast episode.
completenessNotes.ss-07: Number is explicit, but this unqualified or short listing does not establish a whole episode.
completenessNotes.ss-08: Official uploader labels this a full episode; metadata only, without playback or reference comparison.
completenessNotes.ss-09: The part label applies to an explicitly named segment/street-story/credit excerpt, not a numbered chunk of the whole broadcast.
completenessNotes.ss-10: Official upload described as multiple full episodes. Chapters and episode labels identify contents where supplied; complete playback was not reviewed.
completenessNotes.ss-13: Uploader labels a shorter broadcast edit. This is not evidence of an uncut original broadcast.
completenessNotes.ss-15: Uploader labels this copy incomplete, partial or edited. Part labels are uploader labels. Continuity, missing parts and completeness have not been checked.
completenessNotes.ss-16: Uploader labels a version from a different season than the published production identity; the altered programme composition is unresolved.
completenessNotes.ss-20: Uploader presents a numbered episode, with no partial or excerpt qualifier; metadata only. No playback or reference comparison. The part label occurs in the plot/story-arc description of a programme-length numbered episode; it is retained as an arc label, not a split-upload label.
completenessNotes.ss-21: Uploader presents a numbered episode, with no partial or excerpt qualifier; metadata only. No playback or reference comparison. Uploader title includes a date more than a year earlier than the published first broadcast for the claimed number; identity requires review.
completenessNotes.ss-24: Official upload described as multiple full episodes. Chapters and episode labels identify contents where supplied; complete playback was not reviewed. The episode identity set is resolved from description/reference evidence; this does not establish uncut contents or complete playback.
completenessNotes.ss-25: Uploader explicitly warns that the audio is incorrect; this is not an unmodified audio reference for the claimed episode.
completenessNotes.ss-27: Official upload described as multiple full episodes. Chapters and episode labels identify contents where supplied; complete playback was not reviewed. Composition is only partly identified; supported component numbers are retained separately in compositionEvidence and are excluded from coverage …
completenessNotes.ss-28: Uploader labels this copy incomplete, partial or edited.
completenessNotes.ss-29: Uploader labels a selection of Muppet segments/highlights from the identified episode. Metadata only; not a whole broadcast.
completenessNotes.ss-30: Multiple episode labels are present, but the short listing runtime cannot support a collection of whole broadcasts.
completenessNotes.ss-31: Uploader presents a numbered episode, with no partial or excerpt qualifier; metadata only. No playback or reference comparison. Listing is unusually long for a single programme; extra material, repetition or additional episodes may be present. Boundaries are unreviewed.
completenessNotes.ss-34: Official uploader labels this a full episode; metadata only, without playback or reference comparison. The episode reference explicitly marks this exact upload as edited; cuts were not independently compared.
